title: Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa Conjecture for General Abelian Groups
exact_target: Can every finite set with small additive doubling in any abelian group be covered efficiently by translates of a low-dimensional convex coset progression?

sources.citation: Tom Sanders, "The structure theory of set addition revisited," Bulletin (New Series) of the American Mathematical Society, Volume 50, Number 1, January 2013, Pages 93-127; S 0273-0979(2012)01392-7, published electronically October 2, 2012.
